messages:
julia: Heads up — Odyssey Inc (prod) Dedicated rollout planned TOMORROW 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Requesting final capacity handshake + release notes sync. KMS rotation scheduled 02:30 UTC. Need go/no-go from eng + ops by 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC. TL;DR: model v2.3.1-quant, expected qps +22%.

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK -> capacity reservation: gpu-pool-dedicated-5 ✅, canary slice reserved: slice-odyssey-7 ✅, infra alerts: none, KMS collision: none. Estimated token throughput bump: +18-25%. To run plan: ```/deploy plan --tenant odyssey --pool gpu-pool-dedicated-5 --model v2.3.1-quant --canary slice-odyssey-7``` 

marcus: Which variant are we pinning for primary traffic? v2.3.1-quant or v2.4-avg? need to know quantization tradeoffs for latency.

julia: pinning v2.3.1-quant for initial rollout (lower mem, slightly higher latency tail). v2.4-avg is candidate for later warm rollout once KV cache is primed. Release notes will call this out.

sophie: What's rollback criteria? latency p95 > 500ms for 5m or error rate > 1% for 10m? Also any customer-facing downtime window?

andrew: Proposed rollback thresholds: p95 > 700ms for 10m -> auto-fallback to v2.2.9-stable; error rate > 0.8% sustained 15m -> manual rollback. Runbook excerpt: "if canary fails, pause cutover, revert traffic to previous slice, run diag script: ```/ops/check-kv-cache odyssey```" 

deploybot: DEPLOY PLAN CREATED (ID: dp-4765432100). Canary rollout steps scheduled. Notifying oncall.

olivia: Ops + oncall acked. KMS team: note we have a rotation at 02:30 UTC; confirm no key swap during cutover? @kms-team

julia: @kms-team please confirm. If they bump, we delay cutover 1h.

kms-team: (bot) KMS rotation window cleared. No key swaps during 02:00-03:30 UTC.

marcus: FYI perf test ran on staging yesterday: tail latency spike isolated to cache-warmup first 5k requests. We'll prime cache with synthetic workload 30m before go. Command: ```/run prime --tenant odyssey --requests 5000``` 

sophie: Adding this to release notes: 'Cache priming will occur 30m pre-cutover; short elevated CPU on GPUs expected during priming.'

julia: OK — final checklist: docs updated, release notes posted, runbook attached to deploy plan, oncall + ops acked. Go/no-go by 18:00 UTC.

marcus: :thumbsup: from infra

andrew: :white_check_mark: ops

julia: GO for cutover. Proceeding with preflight priming 01:30 UTC tomorrow. I'll post final deploybot announce once plan is executed.

deploybot: DEPLOY STARTED dp-4765432100 — initiating canary slice slice-odyssey-7 at 02:00 UTC.

deploybot: CANARY OK -> metrics within thresholds after 12 minutes. Proceeding to ramp.

sophie: Monitoring — p95 stable ~320ms, error rate 0.12%. no anomalies.

andrew: rolling to 50% traffic now.

deploybot: RAMP COMPLETE -> 100% traffic on v2.3.1-quant. dp-4765432100 complete. Post-deploy note: remember to update model pin in customer tenant config if needed.

julia: Release notes link: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/odyssey-2026-03-22

olivia: Nice work everyone. Closing thread. :party_parrot:
